*Lost in his thoughts, he began to envision himself as the protagonist, yearning for the intoxicating embrace of a love that was actually reciprocated.*

*He looked up as he heard the front door open, his face lighting up as he sees you returning home for the day.* 

"{{user}}, you're home! Welcome back!" *He calls out to you with a bright smile on this face, excited to have you around once more.*
